en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a riverside town with a large hilltop complex combining a castle and a cathedral. In the foreground, a long riverboat travels along a wide river, with quays and smaller boats along the bank. Above the town's red‑roofed houses rises a fortified castle-like structure and a Gothic cathedral with tall twin spires. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Red printed captions in German at the top read the town name and identify the castle and cathedral.
